generator.sampling: Independent RNG streams for anonymous geometry, property permutation, action paths, appearance family, and candidate order. Reject geometry only for overlap/visibility. Do not reject paths for cost, optimum, or bypass. Four exchangeable paths share start/goal on opposite boundary sides and have two random interior waypoints. Property swaps preserve all paths, cards, shape occupancy, family and background render seed.

training_comparison: Same captured architecture, optimizer, augmentations, loss, checkpoint selection rule, model seeds and image/epoch/time ceilings. Balanced changes half of legacy train AND validation images, as in the prior diagnostic. Independent changes both train AND validation geometry/property distributions. Actual epochs/steps are reported; early stopping may differ. No learned cost labels enter visual training.

primary.contrast: legacy minus balanced formula regret, averaged across variants, candidates selected by uniform predicted ties, nontrivial cards A/C/D, scene pairs, and five paired training seeds
primary.claim_pass: Crossed seed-and-scene paired bootstrap 95% lower bound of regret reduction > 0, AND upper bound of balanced minus legacy false-safe micro rate <= 0.01. Otherwise the joint confirmation claim fails.

secondary: independent versus balanced on all splits
trivial_card: B is retained in raw arrays but excluded from primary aggregate metrics and coverage.

calibration_rule.score: Per calibration scene pair: maximum positive truth-minus-predicted cost over both variants, every candidate and nontrivial card.
calibration_rule.quantile: Order statistic ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)), clipped costs after adding the resulting nonnegative offset; card B remains zero. Fit separately for each model/recipe using only the fixed independent calibration set. No threshold tuning on test.
calibration_rule.scope: A pair-block split-conformal upper-cost calibration under IID exchangeability; no distribution-free coverage claim for appearance/shape shifts or legacy-regression. It bounds synthetic cost, not physical collision risk.

uncertainty.method: Independently resample the five model-seed indices and scene-pair indices; preserve recipe pairing, variants, candidate/card dependence and shared test scenes. Report per-seed values and a separate conditional scene-only interval. Five seeds remain a limited estimate of training variability.
uncertainty.multiplicity: Only the stated primary joint claim is confirmatory. Secondary intervals are descriptive without multiplicity adjustment.

integrity_failure_conditions: cross-split RGB or unordered-geometry hash overlap
pair footprints or swapped target invariant fails
any random split has fewer than 60 eligible changed-optimum card pairs
data_access: Freeze protocol and source hashes on Quest before dataset creation. Generate/inspect disjoint self-test fixtures only before freeze. Test files are opened by runner only after checkpoint export and calibration persistence. Dataset QA uses geometry/truth, no learned predictions. No adaptive rerun under this version.
resources: All generation, tests, training, scoring and figures run in Quest Slurm allocations. Reuse existing environment; up to three simultaneous single-GPU jobs. No paid VLM calls and no closed-loop actor training.
